chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
The founding party arrived in summer. It included Thorrik Hakonarson, Biret, Dervla, Áilu, Aodhín, Leofhild, Ingvald Eiriksson, Lemmikki, Dervorgilla and Mieli.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.

Thorrik Hakonarson, Biret, Aodhín and Dervorgilla worked as woodworkers. Dervla worked as a farmer. Áilu, Leofhild and Lemmikki worked as hunters. Ingvald Eiriksson and Mieli worked as fishers.

Mieli and Dervla were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
